race.comment: HEADWALL (3) held up in traffic back in the field when resuming from a long layoff with a slashing second to Tempted in the G2 Concorde over 1000m at this track. Will relish the extra trip and fast tempo. Can go one better here. JOLIESTAR (2) resumes after her gallant third in the G1 Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot three months ago. Wasn't knocked about in both trials and did win this race last year off a similar set-up. Leading player. NINJA (1) kept fresh since defeating inferior opposition first up in the G2 Missile Stakes over 1200m at this track six weeks ago. Since fitted with a 900m trial at Rosehill. Jumps in weight from a sticky draw and place preferred. KING'S SECRET (9) savaged the line first up from back in the field when fourth in the G2 Concorde. Back in good order and best form is over this trip.
